newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-LE GUEN SIGNS FOR TWO MORE YEARS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LE GUEN SIGNS FOR TWO MORE YEARS.

text.p: International central defender Paul Le Guen has signed a two-year contract with French league leaders Paris St Germain.
PSG wanted Le Guen, 32, to take off-pitch responsibilities in the coming months but he has chosen to play on.
Le Guen may become club president in 1999, replacing Michel Denisot, club sources said.
International defender Bruno Ngotty and striker Patrice Loko said they had been approached by foreign clubs and want to be released at the end of the season.
